title: The Birth of a Hero Duo?

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: {0} and his group proceed through the Tower of Luna. Hiyori and Matsuri look curiously at the tower's interior.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ルナの塔を進む{0}一行。
ヒヨリとマツリは珍しそうに塔の内部を見ていた。

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: So this is the Tower of Luna, huh? What a strange atmosphere...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ここがルナの塔ッスか。
変わった雰囲気ッスね……

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: You can say that again... Hah! Matsuri-chan! Behind you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだねー……
マツリちゃん！　
後ろ！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: A monster! Incoming!
text_block_list.orig_text:
魔物ッス！
出たッスね～！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Yes! All right, Matsuri-chan, let's go! I'll support your movements, so act as you see fit!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん！　
よし、
それじゃあマツリちゃん、
いっくよー！
あたしがサポートするから、
好きに動いて！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: A-All right, pal! TEIYAAAAAA!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わ、
分かったッス！
てやーッス！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: Gyaoooooo!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: I did it, pal! My true power is shining brightly today!
text_block_list.orig_text:
やったッス！
これが自分の実力ッスよー！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Just when I thought I had achieved victory, more and more started showing up! Aaah! One went past me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
倒したと思ったら
どんどん出てくるッス！
ああっ！　
一匹そっちにいっちゃったッスよ！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: It's okay! Leave that one to me! TORYAAAAAAH!
text_block_list.orig_text:
大丈夫！
あたしに任せて！　
とりゃあああっ！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: Gyaoooooo!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: W-Wow, she's amazing! She got rid of that one so easily...
text_block_list.orig_text:
す、
すごいッス！
簡単に倒しちゃったッス……

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Matsuri-chan! Stay focused and keep going!
text_block_list.orig_text:
マツリちゃん！　
この調子でいくよ！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: S-Sure, pal!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
は、
はいッス！！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: Gyaoooooo!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Whew... All those monsters showing up made me start wondering about what'd happen, but things worked out quite well somehow...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふうう……
魔物がたくさん出てきたときは
どうなるかと思ったッスけど
なんとかなったッス……

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Everyone! Are you hurt?
text_block_list.orig_text:
みんな、
怪我はない？

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: We're okay, pal! And it was all thanks to you, Hiyori-san. You took out the enemies that were going for my blind spot, truly a lifesaver!
text_block_list.orig_text:
大丈夫ッス！　
ヒヨリさんのおかげッス。
自分の死角の敵を倒してくれたから
すごく助かったッスよ。

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: It was like you knew where they were going beforehand! That was amazing!
text_block_list.orig_text:
まるで
そこに来るのが分かってたみたいだったッス！
すごかったッスよ！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: He-he-he, I'm a big deal, aren't I?! ...Or so I'd like to say, but it's just a coincidence...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふっふっふ、
すごいでしょ！
……って言いたいところだけど
たまたまっていうか……

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Rei and I are usually on the front lines together, so I'm quite used to working together with sword-wielding companions.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いつもはレイさんとあたしで前衛をしてるから
剣を持った仲間とのコンビネーションには
慣れてるんだ。

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Rei-san... Ah, that's right! You and Rei-san are in the same guild, Hiyori-san! She also helped me out a lot before!
text_block_list.orig_text:
レイさんって……
そ
うだったッス！
ヒヨリさんとレイさんは
同じギルドだったッスね！
自分、
前にお世話になったッス！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: But, that Rei-san... thinking back, she's really a marvel of strength. Completely different from what I am...
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
レイさんって
すっごく強かったッスよ。
自分なんかとは
全然違うッス……

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Certainly, I can see why you'd think so highly of Rei, so the desire of comparing yourself to her is understandable.
text_block_list.orig_text:
確かに
レイさんはとっても強いから
比べちゃう気持ちも分かるなあ。

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: But you know, I also really like your straightforward way of fighting, Matsuri-chan. It makes it very easy to get along with you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
でもね、
あたしはマツリちゃんの戦い方、
まっすぐで好きだよ。
なんだかとっても合わせやすいんだもん。

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Straightforward, you say... what do you mean by that?
text_block_list.orig_text:
まっすぐ……
って
どういうことッスかね？

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: You think that it's really "like me", huh? I've no idea what that's trying to imply, so maybe it's a compliment?
text_block_list.orig_text:
自分らしい、
ッスか……
よく分かんないッスけど
褒められてるッスかね？

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Yep, yep! It makes it clear that you're wielding your sword to protect everyone!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うんうん！
みんなを守るために振るっている剣だって
伝わってくるもん。

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Hehehe, no! That's not it! Let me think how to put it... It makes me see what you're feeling, Matsuri-chan. I want to protect everyone! That is what's on your mind while fighting, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうじゃないよ！　
なんていうのかな……
マツリちゃんの気持ちが
よく伝わってくるんだ。
みんなを守ろう！　
って思ってるでしょ？

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: T-That's exactly it... Hiyori-san, you're amazing! I'm surprised you figured it out just like that!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お、
思ってるッス……
ヒヨリさん、
すごいッス！　
よく分かったッスね！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: That just goes to show I'm still inexperienced in swordsmanship, all I can do is attract enemies to protect everyone else...
text_block_list.orig_text:
自分、
まだまだ剣の腕が未熟ッスから、
敵を引き付けて
みんなを守るくらいしか
できないッス……

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: I'm sure that doing so for the sake of your friends motivates you a lot. The same goes for me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
仲間のためだからこそ、
一生懸命になれるんだよね。
それはあたしも同じだよ。

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: And that's exactly why it's so easy for me to get along with you, Matsuri-chan! I think we make a good team.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんなわけで、
マツリちゃんにはすっごく合わせやすいんだ。
あたしたち、
いいコンビなんじゃないかな？

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: The two of us... a good team? I'm so happy to hear that! ...Hah! That's right!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いいコンビッスか？
そう言ってもらえるとうれしいッス！
……ハッ！　
そうッス！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: What's wrong, Matsuri-chan?
text_block_list.orig_text:
どうしたの？
マツリちゃん。

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: I've just had a flash of genius, pal! Hiyori-san, you should become a hero together with me! We'll become a hero duo!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょうどいいッスよ！
ヒヨリさんも
自分と一緒にヒーローになればいいッス！
コンビでヒーローになるッスよ！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: EEEEEEHHHHHH? Me, a hero?
text_block_list.orig_text:
えええ？　
あたしが、
ヒーロー？

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Ehh...? EHEHHHHH!? Hearing that out of nowhere is kind of troublesome...
text_block_list.orig_text:
え、
ええ～？
そんなこと急に言われても
困っちゃうなあ……

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: I-It's hard to refuse when you're the one asking me, but for someone like me that's...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ、
そう言われちゃうと断りづらいけど、
あたしには無理だよ～……

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Don't worry, pal! You're strong, kind, cool... And above all, you've got a righteous heart! All the markings to become a great hero, Hiyori-san!
text_block_list.orig_text:
大丈夫ッス！
強いし
優しいし
カッコいい！　
そしてなにより
正義の心があるッス！
ヒヨリさんなら
立派なヒーローになれるッスよ！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Come on, let's aim to become a hero duo together from now on!
text_block_list.orig_text:
さあ、
自分と一緒に
ダブルヒーローを目指すッス！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Ahahaha... Somehow, things have taken an interesting turn...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あははは……
なんだか
大変なことになっちゃった……

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: A confused Hiyori and an enthusiastic Matsuri. The adventure in the Tower of Luna proceeds with these two contrasting personalities.
text_block_list.orig_text:
困惑するヒヨリと、乗り気なマツリ。
対照的な二人と共に、ルナの塔での冒険は続くのであった。
